messages:
tara: Friday LAN at 7pm in the lounge. Tiny idea: 'Speedrun warmup' rounds for 15 mins then freeplay. Who can bring a small switch and extra extension cords?

matt: Ill bring a 5-port switch + 2x Cat6. Also a duffel of spare controllers (PS/Xbox).

diego: Deck + 45W bank. Ive got a USB-C->HDMI dongle if someone wants to mirror.

sophie: RSVP: Sophie - PC (tower), 24 monitor, and snacks. I can also bring a portable speaker.

tara: Can we label outlets this time so router doesn't get unplugged? Last time was chaos :sweat_smile:

matt: i'll bring masking tape + sharpie.

lan-bot: Reminder: RSVP by Thursday 4pm. Current headcount: 6. Please list device type.

diego: small note: anyone want to swap a controller for a quick Rocket League 2v2?

sophie: in for Rocket League.

tara: plan: 7:00 start, 7:15 speedrun warmups (Mario Kart), 8:00 freeplay + scoreboard, 9:30 optional mini tournament. Food: bring-your-own, but i'll order two pizzas if people chip in.

matt: sounds perfect. Count me in for the pizza fund.

tara: sweet. I'll post final RSVP and table map tomorrow. If devices change, update the thread.
